purpose: Prove third-party project-file container boundaries can be decoded far enough to bind dimensions, frame count, and content hashes to a Mechagotchi sidecar without claiming native editor semantics.

external_anchors.used_for: Piskel JSON envelope fields, layer strings, chunks, and base64 PNG chunk layout.
Piskel modelVersion branching and layer JSON-string parsing boundary.
.pxo as a zip containing data.json and image_data frame assets.
ASE little-endian header, magic number, dimensions, color depth, and frame header.
LibreSprite is treated as a GPL fork boundary; this lab does not embed editor code.

limitations: Stage 0 parses third-party project container boundaries only.
Semantic grid metadata is restored from the Mechagotchi sidecar.
No embedded PNG metadata writer or native project-file writer is claimed.
